senses.gloss: m. (גָּפַף or גּוּף) sealer of wine vessels.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:3">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> top <he>שיתומהון דרבנן מעשה מ׳</he> (not <he>מעש</he>) the boring of which the Rabbis speak (Mish.
